pins.definition: Saturday and Sunday, as a rest period at the end of the week.
Saturday and Sunday, the days at the end of the week when many people do not work.
Saturday and Sunday, or any non-working days when people rest from work or school.

situation: A man hangs up his office lanyard and work badge on a kitchen hook beside his front door, leaving them behind for two full days.
subject: the two free days at the end of the week
brief: A wall calendar hangs in a warm kitchen, and the squares for Saturday and Sunday are brightly filled with a solid bold block of sunshine yellow, completely cleared of any written appointments or tasks. An office lanyard hangs silently on a brass hook right beside the calendar, left untouched.
